document.name: New York Botanical Garden Science Camp (2026)
document.shortDescription: Bronx day camp at NYBG for children entering grades 1-6, with hiking, experiments, art, and outdoor science exploration on the Garden's 250-acre campus.
document.longDescription:
New York Botanical Garden publishes Science Camp as a summer day camp for students entering grades 1 through 6 in Fall 2026. The official camps page lists two sessions: July 6-24, 2026 and August 3-21, 2026, both running from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.

The official description says campers spend the day outdoors on NYBG's 250-acre campus hiking, experimenting, creating art, and playing with fellow campers and staff. Weekly themes on the same page include junior botanists, woodland adventures, and wild wetlands.

Published tuition for Science Camp is $1485 for members and $1650 for non-members. The official page also lists optional extra care on a weekly basis: early drop-off at 8 a.m., late pickup at 5 p.m., and extended pickup until 6 p.m., with separate fees and pre-registration required. The camps FAQ says all camp programs check in and out at the NYBG Main Entrance (Visitor Center) at 2900 Southern Boulevard, Bronx, NY 10458. Registration support listed on the official pages: childed@nybg.org and 718.817.8181.

Sources: https://www.nybg.org/education/childrens-education/kids-teens/camps/ https://www.nybg.org/education/childrens-education/kids-teens/camps/camps-faq/ https://www.nybg.org/content/uploads/2025/10/MCO-DSC03497-1.1.jpg
